Name: BLADE_HOMING_AUTO_CANCEL_ENABLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Conditions that end blade homing (the tracking movement of a melee blade attack): angle and distance limits, and the timings used when there is no lock-on target.

Fields.Name: Tracking Interrupt: Right Angle
Fields.Description: Interrupt above the specified right angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Tracking Interrupt: Left Angle
Fields.Description: Interrupt above the specified left angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Tracking Interrupt: Upward Angle
Fields.Description: Tracking stops when the target is above this angle, measured from the horizontal. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Tracking Interrupt: Downward Angle
Fields.Description: Tracking stops when the target is below this angle, measured from the horizontal. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Tracking Interrupt: Cancel Distance
Fields.Description: Interrupted within this distance. -1 = infinity = no interruption at distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Minimum Homing Time without Lock
Fields.Description: Minimum blade homing duration when there is no lock-on target, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Blade Homing Effective Distance
Fields.Description: When the target is beyond this distance, the no-lock behaviour is used. -1: always use the locked behaviour. In metres.
